svg.title: Paying with Midtrans
svg.desc: 1. Checkout checks the price, blocks duplicate pending orders and reserves any coupon atomically. 2. A pending transaction is written and a Midtrans Snap token is issued; the owner pays with QRIS, e-wallet, virtual account or card. 3. The webhook is rate limited and verified with the SHA512 signature in constant time. 4. Settlement checks the amount and flips pending to completed in one database transaction together with its effects, such as extending the plan. 5. After commit: receipt email with PDF, container start and product install. A reconcile worker asks Midtrans every 5 minutes about orders still pending.
